mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through sustained monetary easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% for 3 consecutive months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative sentiment and S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 months, or interaction Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness, indicating economic slowdown and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPIAUCSL above 2.0% signals rising inflation, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0% annually, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) declining >5% MoM signals real estate weakness, reducing household wealth and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when HOUST declines >5% MoM, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) suppresses wage growth and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through sustained labor slack.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production decline (INDPRO < 106.0) indicates manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 106.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
